description: Implementation of kernel object core management functions including initialization, linking, unlinking, and statistics handling within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: k_obj_type_init
methods.description: Initializes a k_obj_type structure, adds it to the global list, and sets its ID and offset.

methods.name: k_obj_core_init
methods.description: Initializes a kernel object core with a specified type.

methods.name: k_obj_core_link
methods.description: Links a kernel object core into its type list with thread safety.

methods.name: k_obj_core_init_and_link
methods.description: Initializes and links a kernel object core.

methods.name: k_obj_core_unlink
methods.description: Removes a kernel object core from its type list with thread safety.

methods.name: k_obj_type_find
methods.description: Finds a kernel object type by its ID from the global list.

methods.name: k_obj_type_walk_locked
methods.description: Iterates over all kernel objects of a type with the lock held, calling a callback function.

methods.name: k_obj_type_walk_unlocked
methods.description: Iterates over all kernel objects of a type without holding the lock, calling a callback function.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_register
methods.description: Registers statistics buffer for a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_deregister
methods.description: Deregisters statistics buffer for a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_raw
methods.description: Retrieves raw statistics data from a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_query
methods.description: Queries statistics data from a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_reset
methods.description: Resets statistics data for a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_disable
methods.description: Disables statistics collection for a kernel object core if supported.

methods.name: k_obj_core_stats_enable
methods.description: Enables statistics collection for a kernel object core if supported.
